source: Vision read of ALL 19 of the 19 flyer pages (weekly-1..19) installed by pull-fareway-ads.ps1 at 06:21 on 2026-09-20 (ad_group OmahaGroup (043); ad-window.json and fareway-ad-manifest-2026-09-20.json both report 19/19 pages on disk, no gaps, and the installer removed the previous ad's 20th page). Read by the grocery-browser-stores-refresh agent at 06:30-06:50 on 2026-09-20. WINDOW TAKEN FROM THE AD'S OWN PRINTED FOOTER on page 1, 'Prices good Setpember 21 - 26, 2026' (Fareway's own typo for September). THE MANIFEST DISAGREES AND THE FOOTER WINS: the manifest and ad-window.json say from=2026-09-20, one day earlier than the printed start - the same one-day offset the 2026-09-14 ad had, so it is the feed's habit and not a one-off. GAP DAY: the previous ad (fareway-deals-2026-09-17.json) covered 09-14..09-19 and expired last night, and this one does not start until 09-21, so Fareway has NO ad rows on the board for 2026-09-20 itself. That is the ad calendar, not a missed capture. EXCLUDED, deliberately, as prices the board cannot verify per unit: every explicit 'WHEN YOU BUY N', 'SAVE $X WHEN YOU BUY N', BOGO / 'BUY 1 GET 1 50% OFF' / 'BUY 2 GET 1 FREE' / 'BUY 1 GET 1 FOR A PENNY', FREE-with-purchase and gift-card-with-basket offers. Simple N/$X IS recorded, at its arithmetic unit price, with the multibuy kept in the item text. ALSO EXCLUDED, and this is the one judgement call worth re-reading: the WHOLE OF PAGE 8, the '2 DAY SALE - FRIDAY & SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 25 & 26'. Those ~11 prices are real and simple, but they are good for 2 of the window's 6 days, and this file's schema carries ad_from/ad_to only at FILE level, so recording them here would claim 09-21..09-26 availability for a price valid 09-25..09-26. Excluding loses two days of a real deal; including it would publish a wrong price on four. The items left out are: Fareway Chocolate 1% Lowfat Milk gallon $4.44, New York Strip Steak 8 oz $8.88, All-Natural Bone-In Pork Butt $1.88/lb, Premium Saltines or Oyster Crackers 9-16.96 oz $2.88, Jack's Pizza 12 in 4/$10, Jimmy Dean Bacon 12 oz $3.88 (limit 4), Muscle Milk shakes 12 pk 11 oz $19.99, Cameron's Coffee EcoPods 32 ct $14.99 (limit 2), Little Debbie Snack Packs 6-12 ct 2/$4.50. Pages 10 (spirits & wine) and the beer half of page 9 carry no tracked grocery commodity and were read but contributed nothing. King's Hawaiian Grab & Go Sandwich Trays 16 ct was excluded too: it prices $9.99 WEDNESDAYS ONLY and $19.99 all other days, which is a day-conditional this schema cannot express either.
